To lower the cost of prescription drugs, we need to get Big Pharma out of the way and focus on patients.

My STOP GAMES Act does just that - cracks down on Big Pharma dirty tactics. https://t.co/ouwwJoTORK

My STOP GAMES Act does just that - cracks down on Big Pharma dirty tactics. https://t.co/0c6AOInwQh

It’s Medicare Open Enrollment season!

That means it’s time to compare coverage options and make the best decisions for your needs. 

And this year, seniors will have drug costs capped and pay no more than $35/month for insulin, thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act. https://t.co/JXOhdYevES

I know the cost of healthcare is way too high.

Which is why I'm urging Illinoisans in need of coverage to search for plans on the ACA marketplace this enrollment period. 4 out of 5 enrollees can find a plan for $10/month or less.

Visit https://t.co/qGGGnY0ix2 by December 15.
Wishing the Chairman and his family a speedy recovery as he undergoes treatment.

Big win for #IL17 families: The administration just repealed part of a harmful “Refusal of Care” rule that allowed providers to deny care based on personal beliefs.

This dangerous rule had huge impacts, including on women seeking abortions and LGBTQ+ patients.

Perks Family Equine Center at Lockwood Park is set to harness (no pun intended) the power of animals to help children grow.

I was excited to visit their unique facility and learn more about this method of supporting Rockford kids with one-of-a-kind mental health treatment. https://t.co/taWe8zUh5s

We knew the assault on women’s freedom wouldn't stop with Roe being overturned. Now extreme decisions at the state level are putting IVF treatment at risk.

Congress needs to act to restore the right to safe, accessible reproductive care nationwide.
https://t.co/EbuBClBBjx

In the wake of Dobbs, women are crossing state lines to get reproductive health care in Illinois.

I support @RepCaraveoMD's ACCESS Act so #IL17 providers can get resources to help patients.

From @kwqcnews🎥 https://t.co/34tSdwOLUD

In hometowns like German Valley, our neighbors can't afford tax increases to pay for old infrastructure.

That's why I'm working to secure $5,000,000 to repair German Valley's wastewater treatment plant, upgrade the water system, and lower costs for families. https://t.co/1vL9cDH5wD

One of the nation’s largest insurance companies, State Farm, is headquartered in #IL17.

And as our country processes the scope of the CA wildfires, it’s important to make sure those insured are taken care of and premiums stay affordable for our neighbors back home. (1/2) https://t.co/2gBpneUNFx

Important visit to Chestnut Health Systems in Bloomington to learn more about their life-changing work providing mental health care, addiction treatment, dental, and primary care to our neighbors—many of whom rely on Medicaid and NIH funding.

As conversations in Washington continue, I’m committed to protecting the resources that keep our communities healthy and strong.

Hospitals across our district are sounding the alarm if the House GOP follows through to cut $880,000,000,000 from Medicaid.

It’s not just that poor Americans lose service, we all will when rural hospitals and clinics close down.

I met with @IHAHospitals to talk about how we can keep the doors open and ensure that people remain connected to health care.

It doesn’t matter what political party you belong to or the number of years lived, our shared kindness means we wish everyone speedy recovery after a cancer diagnosis. 

I know Joe Biden to be a kind man with a gentle heart and I join my neighbors in wishing him swift healing following his prostate cancer diagnosis.

House Republicans just passed the largest cut to Medicaid in American history.

They are taking health care away from millions of Americans so they can cut taxes for their billionaire buddies.

Whose side are they on? https://t.co/zvoc5TI1qA

Head Start is about lifting people out of poverty and making sure kids aren’t crying themselves to sleep at night.

Our neighbors benefit enormously from this successful program.

As the GOP threatens cuts. I am fighting to make sure Head Start in Bloomington and around #IL17 has the funding they need.

https://t.co/xl5r0BGCzB

“We have a sick care system – not a health care system.”

“Government’s job is to help people. It’s not a business.”

“People will give up on healthcare.”

These are some of the important lessons learned at our roundtable on Medicaid and Medicare in our communities. 

Everyone should understand that cutting service only shifts the burden and will actually increase costs for our neighbors.

A woman’s right to make her own healthcare decisions was ripped away and placed in the hands of Republican politicians with the Dobbs decision.

I will never ease up on the fight for the majority of Americans who believe individuals – not politicians – should have freedom over their own bodies.

This week, I’m proud to reintroduce the Women’s Health Protection Act that would enshrine a woman’s right to choose.

Thank you for your work, AARP Illinois!

Together, we will protect Medicare and fight to lower the cost of prescriptions.

Stripping seniors from their safety net while giving billionaires a hand out is wrong and I will fight every day to protect my neighbors.

The Senate passed the worst legislation for working families in a generation.

🏥Kicking 17 MILLION Americans off their health insurance
🥫Taking $300 BILLION worth of food from hungry people
💰Jacking up the debt by $4 TRILLION

Why? → Trillion dollar tax breaks for the rich.

Right now, I’m on the plane to Washington to vote HELL NO when this bill gets to the House. I’m doing everything I can to protect every one of our neighbors.

The president’s bill is ugly, horrific, and un-American!

I won’t stand by while Washington plays politics with food and healthcare for Illinois families. https://t.co/D5R1JsZeaP

Touring Project NOW’s Head Start, I saw what’s really at stake.

➡️ 90% of these kids need Medicaid
➡️ 61% need SNAP

When funding for programs gets cut, it’s not just numbers on a page — it’s families going without the care and meals. 

Our children deserve better. No matter what happens in Washington, I’ll keep fighting to put children and families first.

Did you know Illinois leads the nation in soybeans?

Members of Illinois Soy were on hand to deliver updates on member needs and we talked about crop insurance, trade, and the 40A blender’s tax credit – which I proudly support.

Illinois grows soy better than anybody, which is why I am all-in on the work to support farmers.

I sat down with public health officials from across #IL17 to make sure our hospitals and communities are prepared to deal with the fallout from Republicans’ so-called “big beautiful bill.”

But there’s nothing “beautiful” about ripping health care away from my neighbors.

Together, I’m working with health care leaders in the district to fight to prevent people from losing their health insurance.

60 years ago today, leaders from both parties came together to pass Medicare and Medicaid – that changed American lives for the better.

Unfortunately, only Democrats are keeping the promise today.
→ Protecting Medicare.
→ Defending Medicaid.
→ Fighting against cuts.

These programs are lifelines for families in IL-17, and they’re worth fighting for.
